init.title: Module monitoring
init.description: Silence makes module entities unavailable without reconnecting the gateway. Use 0 to disable a silence timeout. Optional overrides map hexadecimal CAN IDs to seconds, for example `00001879: 120`.

data_description.module_timeout: Seconds since the last received frame; 0 disables the timeout.
data_description.module_timeouts: Mapping of CAN IDs to timeouts in seconds. An empty mapping uses the global timeout.

error.invalid_module_timeout: Use configured hexadecimal CAN IDs and timeouts from 0 to 86400 seconds.

text_migrated.description: The read-only entity `{old_entity_id}` was replaced by `{new_entity_id}`. Update references in automations, scripts, and dashboards. Its name, icon, and area preferences were preserved.

config_required.title: Ampio configuration required
config_required.description:
The legacy YAML file for {name} could not be recovered.

1. Open Settings > Devices & services > Ampio.
2. Select Reconfigure for this entry.
3. Enter the HTTP(S) URL of your YAML configuration and submit it.

After validation, the integration starts using the same configuration entry.
